source.title: Ultimate Syndra Guide MID by GAMING ACADEMY YouTube Channel

fields: He is very weak at levels 1 and 2 and spikes at 3 and 6, so punish him early and crash two or three waves into his tower, then let it bounce back. From level 3 avoid overextending and track his E, his key trading and wave clear tool. Barrier or Exhaust, or an early Null-Magic Mantle, makes the lane easier.

She dominates lane and side lane but needs to snowball to matter in teamfights. Keep the wave on your side for ganks and safety, and respect her level 2 and level 6 all-ins. Staying alive matters more than CS; use E defensively to break her trades.
You have a big edge before level 6, but it gets much harder after. Since you cannot easily force her out of lane, the scaling First Strike page is usually best.

His W is both his trade and farm tool, so do not stand in the wave; make him choose between hitting you and farming. Avoid both halves of the W by sidestepping rather than backing straight off. Respect his Ignite all-ins at levels 2 and 6, and consider extra health, early Cloth Armor, Exhaust or Barrier.

He is weak early with long cooldowns and poor sustain, so build your lead in the first five levels and punish his Q cooldown, especially after his empowered Q. He gets much stronger after level 6 and a back. He will pool to dodge your ultimate, so ult right after landing a stun.
Harder if their jungler is AP. Manage mana carefully and only cast when sure to hit, or you will be left defenseless. Phase Rush and Teleport are recommended.
You should build a solid lead before level 6, after which her ultimate clears waves and blunts your pressure. Rush tier-2 boots to dodge her skillshots.
Easier than it looks; you can bully him all lane. Do not waste your stun, and use your ultimate as poke so he cannot rewind the damage. Phase Rush works well.

Weak in lane except for key moments: avoid her daggers and respect her level 2 and level 6 all-ins. She often roams, so ward and ping when she leaves. Play safer while your E is down, and after 6 save it to disengage or stop her ultimate.
One of the strongest laners. Keep moving to dodge her Q and E while landing yours, and you should come out slightly ahead and outscale her. Mercury's Treads help.
You can bully her hard, but wasting your E gets you punished, especially before level 6. Consider Exhaust or Barrier.
A skill matchup: you win trades and 1v1s, but she sets up ganks very well. Use E to answer her W, and buy Mercury's Treads to survive ganks.
You crush him early, but the lane gets harder as he levels. Use Comet and Teleport to build a big early lead.
He is strong early, but you can still win lane and outscale him. Poke with Q and keep E ready for when he engages.
Her spells are easy to dodge and you outrange her heavily. Beware her level 6 burst, which can kill you if her ultimate lands; Mercury's Treads help.
A skillshot duel; rush tier-2 boots and exploit his much longer cooldowns.
You win the 1v1, but her charm and mobility set up ganks very well. Ward well, position carefully, and play defensively when her jungler is around.
Punish her before level 6 while her cooldowns are long and range short, especially when she goes to farm. She is very gankable; dodge her Q, and extend any pre-6 lead afterward.

He pokes and clears well but is open to trades after spending spells. Keep the wave gankable, use the wave to dodge his Q, and avoid his E. After 6 an E hit can lead to a lethal ultimate, so save your E to interrupt it.
Very easy: exploit his weak trading and wave clear. Watch out for being caged into a gank, especially without Flash.
Fairly easy. Ignite works, but Teleport is better since it lets you respond to his package return.
